evals.name: placement-report
evals.prompt: Where are our workloads allowed to schedule?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage preflight` then `cub manage scheduling placement` (JSON or -o table) and reports each workload's nodeSelector / tolerations / node affinity and whether it is constrained. Read-only.

evals.name: unconstrained
evals.prompt: Which workloads can land on any node?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage scheduling placement --issues-only` and reports workloads with no nodeSelector and no required node affinity.

evals.name: per-cluster-counts
evals.prompt: How many workloads pin a node pool per cluster?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage scheduling snapshot` and reports per-cluster nodeSelector/tolerations/nodeAffinity counts.

evals.name: spread-report
evals.prompt: Do our multi-replica workloads spread across nodes, or do they rely on the cluster default?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage scheduling spread` (JSON or -o table) and reports each workload's spread source (explicit / cluster-default / none) and pod anti-affinity terms, plus each cluster's default spread and its defaultSource (target-fact / managed-distribution / assumed). Read-only.

evals.name: routes-fix-elsewhere
evals.prompt: Add a zone spread constraint to the workloads that rely on the cluster default.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a write and routes to scheduling-spread (`cub manage scheduling set-topology-spread` or `fleet-edit --profile topology-spread-soft`) rather than mutating from this read-only skill.
